description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You draw an Overflow effect that targets a single creature.

Area 10-foot burst within range of the effect

The effect applies to every valid target in the burst instead of to one creature. Each target is affected separately and attempts its own saving throw. The Reckoning advances once for the drawing, not once per target, and an effect that could not legally target a creature simply does not affect it.

cinderfall.incomplete: The 'Reckoning advances only once, not per target' clause -- the Reckoning (this class's own 4-stage penalty track) has zero Foundry-schema footprint: classes.reckoner.json ships "rules": [] and defines no SpecialResource, counter, or stage-tracking rule element of any kind to hook. See feats-class-reckoner-draft.md (RECKONING-BLOCKER). Separately: there is no mechanism to dynamically reshape an arbitrary spell's own targeting (retargeting a future single-target Overflow effect into an AoE).
